comparison.objective: Move only cartons obstructing an invisible photo-eye beam while leaving all cartons upright.

comparison.reason: Selective carton relocation has no meaningful central overlap with aligned mandrel stabilization, hammer impact, notch fracture, and loose-fragment containment.
